Kernel pinned to the py3.12 image (37c64f...).
outcome: +0.002 over u9-b1 (0.888): new best public single model by a hair, but below both predictions (about 0.896 from LM-test, 0.892 from gold-58). Public moved about a quarter of the LM-test gain; within what single-seed noise can produce, and the extra-training-draws confound is unresolved.
